overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice was legible enough, and the handwritten posting date, though hard to read in one digit, was sufficiently legible.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice for the October 12 meeting was not printed in a legible, easily understandable format.
allegations.key_passage: The notice was type-written, posted in three locations, and included the date, time and place of the meeting, as well as a list of topics.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the handwritten posting date and time ("Posted 10/5 @ 10:15 A.M.") on the notice was not legible.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that any potential ambiguity over the date did not rise to the level of an Open Meeting Law violation.
